rule: Release/marketing claims must be listed here, name a compatibility profile and point to retained evidence. Absence from this registry means the claim is not approved for release marketing.

claims.claim: OpenContainer Core owns exactly nine public semantic surfaces.
OpenContainer is a browser-native Node/web development runtime for the declared evidence profile.
Vite 8.3.0 C1 production build and C2 dev/HMR are promoted in the declared Chrome evidence path.
The publish-equivalent installed distribution passes the declared Chrome product path; external publication identity is not implied.
Production diagnostics/support export is bounded and privacy-minimized for the declared Chrome profile.

forbiddenGeneralizations: Do not claim Firefox, Safari, Windows, macOS, mobile or weak-device support from the Chrome/Ubuntu CI receipt.
Do not claim full Node 24 compatibility from selected differential/package/framework evidence.
Do not claim a public npm/GitHub release from publish-equivalent local certification.
Do not claim production/commercial closure while production_closed is false or P16/P17 remain open.
